mn59:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn59:1.3: atha kho pañcakaṅgo thapati yenāyasmā udāyī tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho pañcakaṅgo thapati āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ etadavoca:
mn59:1.4: ‘kati nu kho bhante udāyi, vedanā vuttā bhagavatā’ti.
mn59:1.5: tisso kho thapati. vedanā vuttā bhagavatā:
mn59:1.6: sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā.
mn59:1.7: imā kho thapati, tisso vedanā vuttā bhagavatāti.
mn59:1.9: na kho bhante udāyi, tisso vedanā vuttā bhagavatā,
mn59:1.12: yāyaṃ bhante, adukkhamasukhā vedanā, santasmiṃ esā paṇīte sukhe vuttā bhagavatāti.
mn59:2.1: dutiyampi kho āyasmā udāyī pañcakaṅgaṃ thapatiṃ etadavoca:
mn59:2.2: na kho thapati dve vedanā vuttā bhagavatā,
mn59:2.4: sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā.
mn59:2.5: imā kho thapati, tisso vedanā vuttā bhagavatāti.
mn59:2.6: dutiyampi kho pañcakaṅgo thapati āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ etadavoca:
mn59:2.7: na kho bhante udāyi, tisso vedanā vuttā bhagavatā,
mn59:2.10: yāyaṃ bhante, adukkhamasukhā vedanā, santasmiṃ esā paṇīte sukhe vuttā bhagavatāti.
mn59:3.1: tatiyampi kho āyasmā udāyī pañcakaṅgaṃ thapatiṃ etadavoca:
mn59:3.2: na kho thapati, dve vedanā vuttā bhagavatā,
mn59:3.4: sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā,
mn59:3.5: imā kho thapati, tisso vedanā vuttā bhagavatāti.
mn59:3.6: tatiyampi kho pañcakaṅgo thapati āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ etadavoca:
mn59:3.7: na kho bhante udāyi, tisso vedanā vuttā bhagavatā,
mn59:3.10: yāyaṃ bhante, adukkhamasukhā vedanā, santasmiṃ esā paṇīte sukhe vuttā bhagavatāti.
mn59:3.11: neva kho asakkhi āyasmā udāyī pañcakaṅgaṃ thapatiṃ saññāpetuṃ. na panāsakkhi pañcakaṅgo thapati āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ saññāpetuṃ.
mn59:4.1: assosi kho āyasmā ānando āyasmato udāyissa pañcakaṅgena thapatinā saddhiṃ imaṃ kathā sallāpaṃ.
mn59:4.2: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn59:4.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando yāvatako ahosi. āyasmato udāyissa pañcakaṅgena thapatinā saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo, taṃ sabbaṃ bhagavato ārocesi.
mn59:4.4: evaṃ vutte bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca:
mn59:5.1: santaṃyeva kho ānanda, pariyāyaṃ pañcakaṅgo thapati udāyissa nābbhanumodi. santaṃ yeva ca pana pariyāyaṃ udāyī pañcakaṅgassa thapatissa nābbhanumodi.
mn59:5.2: dvepānanda, vedanā vuttā mayā pariyāyena, tissopi vedanā vuttā mayā pariyāyena, pañcapi vedanā vuttā mayā pariyāyena, chapi vedanā vuttā mayā pariyāyena, aṭṭhārasapi vedanā vuttā mayā pariyāyena, chattiṃsāpi vedanā vuttā mayā pariyāyena, aṭṭhasatampi vedanā vuttā mayā pariyāyena.
mn59:5.3: evaṃ pariyāya desito kho ānanda, mayā dhammo.
mn59:5.4: evaṃ pariyāyadesite kho ānanda, mayā dhamme ye aññamaññassa subhāsitaṃ sulapitaṃ na samanujānissanti, na samanumaññissanti, na samanumodissanti, tesametaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ: bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivādāpannā aññamaññaṃ mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharissanti.
mn59:5.5: evaṃ pariyāya desito kho ānanda, mayā dhammo.
mn59:5.6: evaṃ pariyāya desite kho ānanda, mayā dhamme ye aññamaññassa subhāsitaṃ sulapitaṃ samanujānissanti, samanumaññissanti, samanumodissanti, tesametaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ: samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīrodakībhūtā aññamaññaṃ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharissantīti.
mn59:6.3: cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā,
mn59:6.7: kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
mn59:6.9: yaṃ kho ānanda, ime pañcakāmaguṇe paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ idaṃ vuccati kāmasukhaṃ.
mn59:7.1: yo kho ānanda evaṃ vadeyya: etaparamaṃ sattā sukhaṃ somanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedentīti. idamassa nānujānāmi.
mn59:7.3: atthānanda etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
mn59:7.4: katamañcānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca:
mn59:7.5: idhānanda bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn59:7.6: idaṃ kho ānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
mn59:8.1: yo kho ānanda, evaṃ vadeyya: etaparamaṃ sattā sukhaṃ somanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedentīti, idamassa nānujānāmi.
mn59:8.3: atthānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
mn59:8.4: katamañcānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca:
mn59:8.5: idhānanda bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati,
mn59:8.6: idaṃ kho ānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
mn59:9.4: idhānanda, bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhakoca viharati satoca sampajāno, sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti. yantaṃ ariyā ācikkhanti: upekkhako satimā sukha vihārīti. taṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn59:9.5: idaṃ kho ānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
mn59:10.4: idhānanda, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhaṃ asukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn59:10.5: idaṃ kho ānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
mn59:11.4: idhānanda, bhikkhu sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā, paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā, nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ‘ananto ākāso’ti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn59:11.5: idaṃ kho ānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
mn59:12.4: idhānanda, bhikkhu sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘anantaṃ viññāṇa’nti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn59:12.5: idaṃ kho ānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
mn59:13.4: idhānanda, bhikkhu sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘natthi kiñcī’ti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn59:13.5: idaṃ kho ānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
mn59:14.4: idhānanda, bhikkhu sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn59:14.5: idaṃ kho ānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
mn59:15.1: yo kho ānanda, evaṃ vadeyya: etaparamaṃ sattā sukhaṃ somanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedentīti, idamassa nānujānāmi.
mn59:15.3: atthānanda etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
mn59:15.4: katamañcānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca:
mn59:15.5: idhānanda, bhikkhu sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn59:15.6: idaṃ kho ānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
mn59:16.1: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ ānanda, vijjati yaṃ aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ:
mn59:16.2: saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samaṇo gotamo āha. tañca sukhasmiṃ paññāpeti.
mn59:16.4: evaṃ vādino ānanda, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evamassu vacanīyā:
mn59:16.5: na kho āvuso, bhagavā sukhaṃyeva vedanaṃ sandhāya sukhasmiṃ paññāpeti.
mn59:16.6: api cāvuso yattha yattha sukhaṃ upalabbhati. yahiṃ yahiṃ taṃ taṃ tathāgato sukhasmiṃ paññāpetīti.
mn59:16.8: attamano āyasmā ānando bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.
